fact: On 25 August 2026 the vice-president of government agreed that ANINF, the state agency that designed the Fichier unique de référence (FUR), would help fix its coding failures; the application has been operational for about twenty years.
ANINF, the national digital infrastructure agency, designed the FUR application that the public service ministry uses to manage the state's human resources.

Gabonactu reports that the 2026 primary-school certificate (CEP) results were published on 27 June 2026 through the KEWA platform, run by the national digital agency ANINF, with ANINF engineers credited for it.
Gabonactu reports that ANINF, a state agency, ran the KEWA platform that published the Education ministry's CEP 2026 results online on 27 June 2026.
ANINF technicians activated the Réseau de l'Administration Gabonaise fibre network at Oyem, dormant since 2010, bringing the town hall, police station and court onto it.

ANINF, described as the state's operational arm for public digital infrastructure, runs the RAG network serving Oyem's town hall, police station and court, with activation to extend to other administrations; dated by publication.

The document states ANINF, a national agency, is entrusted with securing the State's critical systems, extending the Réseau de l'Administration Gabonaise (RAG) that interconnects public administrations, and supporting administrations in digitising their services; the document is dated 2025-12-22 and gives no earlier date.

ANINF launched SecBOM, a digital-asset mapping system, managed by its own Information Security, Engineering and Networks, and General Affairs directorates; the document names no outside vendor for it.
PROXIGAB, an SME platform, was designed and developed by ANINF's own experts, per the Gabonese press agency.
ANINF signed a minute on 2 October 2026 handing the PROXIGAB solution to the SME directorate-general, a platform it built for another government body.
ANINF experts' PROXIGAB platform was officially presented and handed over on 2 October 2026; the date is the presentation, not stated as first go-live.
The GED electronic document management platform was developed with ANINF's expertise, per Tech Africa News.
ANINF supports administrations including the government secretariat and exams directorate with the GED, document security and user support.
The GED document management system is developed by ANINF, with World Bank and other partner support, per GabonReview.
ANINF is building a shared digital base for the 29 ministries to connect to progressively, starting with two pilot administrations.

ANINF, acting for the Ministry of Digital Economy, installed the LAN, dedicated internet and power equipment for the digital driving-licence enrolment centre in Makokou, through several weeks of work by its own engineers and technicians; the document gives no event date, so as_of is its published date.

ANINF, the state digital agency, designed the FUR civil-service HR and payroll application and is fixing its coding failures.

ANINF's own directorates manage its SecBOM digital-asset mapping system; no outside vendor is named.

ANINF, Gabon's national digital infrastructure agency, says in a 22 January 2026 communique that the state payroll file FUR, designed by its predecessor DGSI and in service for over 20 years, is administered and operated by its own authorised teams.
ANINF says in a 22 January 2026 communique that it administers the FUR payroll application for the Gabonese state, working with the payroll directorate, the Treasury and the pensions fund.
